03 — GOOD TO KNOW

A little clarity.

What is PriorityDesk?+

A Windows-first task and reminder app that brings projects, nested tasks, notes, priorities, due dates, and file attachments together in one workspace.

Can I use it offline?+

Yes. Task and project data are saved locally, so you can keep working without an internet connection. You can choose your data folder in the app’s Options.

Can I sync between computers?+

OneDrive sync is currently a preview feature. It syncs tasks, projects, and attached files while each computer keeps a local copy for offline use. Work and school accounts may need approval from your organisation’s IT administrator.

Is there an Android version?+

An Android companion is in early development. It does not sync yet. The main PriorityDesk experience is the native Windows app.

Can I download it here?+

This website introduces an app still in development. There isn’t a public download on this page yet. In the meantime, explore the interactive preview above with example tasks.
